caption:
The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection is Rockstar's limited Collector's Box inspired by Leonida's TV hit Macca the Gator: a 6-inch Macca figure, Oakley Frogskins sunglasses, a New Era snapback, a Leonida Keys crossbody bag, pins, stickers and a souvenir poster. Arrives November 19 while supplies last, game sold separately. Would you get it?

—

A Goodtime State – Vice City Collection é o box de colecionador limitado da Rockstar inspirado no hit de TV de Leonida, Macca the Gator: figura de 6 polegadas do Macca, óculos Oakley Frogskins, boné snapback New Era, bolsa Leonida Keys, pins, adesivos e pôster. Chega em 19 de novembro, enquanto durarem os estoques, jogo vendido separadamente. Você levaria?
